titles: How Generative AI Works in Practice
Wouri Express Uses AI for Weekly Reports
youtube.description:
Friday at Wouri Express, Mbella needs to write a weekly report from messy driver notes. Tanyi shows how generative AI can draft the report based on given facts and numbers. Learn what generative AI is, how it works, and why accuracy matters.

Chapters
0:00 Hook
0:23 Listening
0:40 Decide: what generative means
1:05 How the draft is made
1:29 Build
1:54 Constraint and fix
2:22 User test
2:36 Where this applies
2:47 Ownership

Fictional teaching scenario. Wouri Express and its people are invented; the setting draws on documented conditions in Douala, Cameroon.
Complex AI. Explained visually. Built practically.
